meta.title: Ri’aya — Intelligent clinic operations
meta.description: Ri’aya helps clinics run calmer days: scheduling, patient flow, and operational clarity in English, Arabic, and French.

hero.subtitle: Ri’aya gives clinical teams a calm, multilingual workspace for appointments, staffing and daily operations — so patients wait less and teams see more clearly.

features.title: Everything the front desk and clinicians share
features.subtitle: One calm workspace that replaces scattered spreadsheets, phone notes and paper queues.
features.s1Body: Keep calendars balanced across doctors, rooms and visit types without the usual back-and-forth.
features.s2Body: Waiting lists, check-in and live status stay visible, so queues stay honest and quiet.
features.s3Body: Spot bottlenecks early with utilization, wait time and cancellation signals you can act on.
features.s4Body: One place for staff, capacity and the day ahead — with a clear picture for every shift.
features.s5Body: Switch between English, Arabic and French instantly, with a native right-to-left layout.
features.s6Body: Admins, doctors and receptionists each see exactly what they need — nothing more.

how.title: From first call to follow-up, in three calm steps
how.subtitle: Ri’aya follows the natural rhythm of a clinic day instead of forcing a new one.
how.s1Body: Find the right doctor and slot, confirm the visit and keep everyone’s calendar in sync.
how.s2Body: Check patients in as they arrive and keep the waiting room moving with live status.
how.s3Body: See wait times, utilization and no-shows, then adjust tomorrow with confidence.

roles.title: One workspace, the right view for each person
roles.subtitle: Permissions follow the role, so every screen stays focused and safe.
